scenario.title: Practice campus Wi-Fi assistant
scenario.text: Practice only; not an assessed case.

partA.fit: Shared model, prompt and retrieval create a common AI dependency.
partA.bound: Advisory-only for practice-v3 and ordinary daytime incidents; model/retrieval/profile changes reopen the decision.
partA.evidence: Daytime test is observed; peak, contradiction and AI-outage tests remain proposed.
partA.technical: Independent control must not rely on the model being correct.

stress.label: PRACTICE STRESS
stress.text: Two operators receive contradictory recommendations after a retrieval refresh.

refitwhy: The retrieval change invalidates the original evidence boundary.
finalDecision: Keep direct control disabled and suspend advisory use until versioned regression evidence is reviewed.
